## What we know

- **Name:** 承泽园 Chengze Yuan (S1200, S1215, S23, S20 · confidence B)
- **In English:** Garden of Received Grace (承晖园 before 1845) (S1200, S1215, S23, S20)
- **What it was:** a neighbouring imperial or princely garden outside the garden walls (S1200, S1215, S23, S20 · confidence B)
- **In 1860:** held by 额驸 景寿 after the death in 1859 of 寿恩固伦公主 (Daoguang's 6th daughter, given 1845) (S1215; S1200); not burned in 1900 (S1200 lead); 1860 fate not stated (S1200, S1215, S23, S20)
- **Where:** C: north of the NW part of 畅春园 and west of 蔚秀园 (S1200 lead; Malone's sketch labels the plot 'Garden of Prince Ch'ing', its holder from 1894); point by eye, not read; its extent, a circle of 110 m, is assumed (S1200, S1215, S23, S20 · confidence C)
- **Note:** Today PKU National School of Development; Beijing municipal protected (2011). 1894 to 奕劻. Called 六公主园.; First holder 允礼 (PKU S1216) or 允禧 (S1215): disagreement. Also: AMS 1944 sheet read at px 2080,515, fit rms 95 m (Chengchaoyüan (?)), 359 m from the point used. (S1200, S1215, S23, S20)
